name: dailies
description: Dailies for your coding agent: record a browser flow as a verifiable session (trace, video, HAR, console) and cut it into a narrated demo video. Ships a sandbox scripting reference, verify/automate/session/review skills, subagents, and workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Record a browser flow, get a demo video and the evidence.
interface.longDescription: Dailies drives a real browser through a flow and hands back something you can watch — a narrated, captioned short of the run — plus the evidence underneath it (Playwright trace, video, network HAR, console, a screenshot of every step) and a replayable Playwright script. It also turns a code change into a prioritized QA plan and reviews recorded runs.
defaultPrompt: Record a demo video of this change.
What should I QA for these changes?
Record a QA session for this flow.
